llmConfig.actionDescription: Use this tool first, before calling an external API, to find out which external APIs you are allowed to call. It takes no inputs. It returns `connections`, a JSON array where each item has `name` (pass this exactly as the `connection` input of the Call external API tool), `description` (what the API is for), `base_url` (paths you request are added to this) and `allowed_methods` (the HTTP methods you may use with it). If the array is empty, no APIs are available: tell the user an admin needs to enable a connection for AI agents in the Custom API Workflow Action settings, and do not try to call any API.

en.actionDescription: Lists the saved API connections that AI agents are allowed to use. Credentials are never shown.
